identification: Set of five red enamel kitchen canisters with black script lettering (Sugar, Rice, Tea, Coffee, Flour), black rims and black knobs, plus a small red enamel pouring saucepan/milk pan with black handle (6 pieces). Rice and Flour canisters have no lids; Tea lid has a worn/repaired knob area; wear and chips likely (sold AS IS). Probably 1930s-50s, maker unknown (candidates: Australian or European enamelware; Nylex, Gayware and Norton sets are similar).
